import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";

it("runs the real isolated production workload smoke and never calls it a reference pass [QLT-05]", () => {
  const child = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--experimental-strip-types", "workload/run.ts", "--smoke"], { encoding: "utf8", timeout: 30_000, killSignal: "SIGKILL" });
  expect(child.status, child.stderr).toBe(0);
  expect(child.stderr).not.toContain("MaxListenersExceededWarning");
  const report = JSON.parse(child.stdout);
  expect(report.mode).toBe("smoke");
  expect(report.referencePass).toBe(false);
  expect(report.qualification).toBe("unqualified");
  expect(report.seed).toEqual({ users: 2000, items: 10000, loans: 50000 });
  expect(report.operations.list.attempts).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(report.operations.reserve.attempts).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(report.operations.return.attempts).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(report.metrics.peakRssBytes).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(report.metrics.eventLoopSamples).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  expect(report.database.duplicateActiveItems).toBe(0);
  for (const probe of report.signInProbes) {
    expect(Object.values(probe.failureReasons).reduce((sum: number, count) => sum + Number(count), 0)).toBe(probe.failures);
  }
  expect(report.cleanup).toEqual({ serverExited: true, writerExited: true, directoryRemoved: true });
}, 35_000);

import { mkdtempSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { buckets, judge, operation, percentiles } from "../../workload/report.ts";
import { seed } from "../../workload/seed.ts";
import { Gate, initialLoans, login, loginFailure } from "../../workload/client.ts";
import Database from "better-sqlite3";
import { z } from "zod";
import { createServer } from "node:http";

it("retains bounded authentication failure categories without exposing credentials or response bodies [QLT-05]", async () => {
  for (const stage of ["csrf", "signin", "session"]) {
    for (const status of [401, 403, 429, 503]) {
      expect(loginFailure(new Error(`${stage}-status-${status}`))).toBe(`${stage}-status-${status}`);
    }
  }
  for (const reason of ["pre-cookie-missing", "session-cookie-missing"]) expect(loginFailure(new Error(reason))).toBe(reason);
  expect(loginFailure(new DOMException("private response", "AbortError"))).toBe("aborted");
  expect(loginFailure(new DOMException("private response", "TimeoutError"))).toBe("timeout");
  expect(loginFailure(new SyntaxError("private response"))).toBe("invalid-json");
  expect(loginFailure(z.string().safeParse({ private: "credential" }).error)).toBe("invalid-response");
  expect(loginFailure(new TypeError("private network URL"))).toBe("type-error");
  for (const error of [new Error("signin-status-503 private credential"), new Error("signin-status-999999"), "private credential", null]) {
    expect(loginFailure(error)).toBe("unexpected-error");
  }
  const server = createServer((request, response) => {
    request.resume();
    response.setHeader("content-type", "application/json");
    if (request.url === "/api/auth/csrf") {
      response.setHeader("set-cookie", "pre_csrf=synthetic; Path=/");
      response.end(JSON.stringify({ csrfToken: "synthetic" }));
    } else {
      response.statusCode = 503;
      response.end(JSON.stringify({ private: "must not enter diagnostics" }));
    }
  });
  await new Promise<void>(resolve => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  try {
    const address = server.address();
    if (!address || typeof address === "string") throw new Error("HTTP fixture did not bind a TCP port");
    const gate = new Gate();
    let posted = 0;
    const failure = await login(`http://127.0.0.1:${address.port}`, 20, "synthetic fixture value", gate, new AbortController().signal, () => posted++)
      .then(() => { throw new Error("refused sign-in succeeded"); }, error => loginFailure(error));
    expect(failure).toBe("signin-status-503");
    expect(posted).toBe(1);
    expect(gate.active).toBe(0);
  } finally {
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
  }
});

function healthy() {
  const all = buckets();
  for (let i = 0; i < 5000; i++) { const b = all[operation(i)]; b.attempts++; b.successfulMs.push(10); b.allMs.push(10); b.statuses["200"] = (b.statuses["200"] ?? 0) + 1; }
  return all;
}
it("declares the requested 70/20/10 cycle [QLT-05]", () => {
  const kinds = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => operation(i));
  expect(["list", "reserve", "return"].map(kind => kinds.filter(k => k === kind).length)).toEqual([70, 20, 10]);
});
it("uses nearest-rank percentiles and leaves absent samples unknown [QLT-05]", () => {
  expect(percentiles([])).toEqual({ samples: 0, p50: null, p95: null, p99: null });
  expect(percentiles(Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => 100 - i))).toEqual({ samples: 100, p50: 50, p95: 95, p99: 99 });
});
it("recognizes measured targets only with sufficient successful samples and coverage [QLT-05]", () => {
  expect(judge("reference", healthy(), { peakRssBytes: 100_000_000, eventLoopSamples: 1000, eventLoopP95Ms: 10 }, 12, 12, 0, true, 1)).toEqual({ referencePass: true, reasons: [] });
});
it.each(["quota", "samples", "memory", "event-loop", "bursts", "invariant", "busy"])("never hides a failed %s target behind fast responses [QLT-05]", failure => {
  const all = healthy(), metrics = { peakRssBytes: 100_000_000, eventLoopSamples: 1000, eventLoopP95Ms: 10 };
  if (failure === "quota") all.list.unexpected = 1;
  if (failure === "samples") all.list.successfulMs = [];
  if (failure === "memory") metrics.peakRssBytes = NaN;
  if (failure === "event-loop") metrics.eventLoopSamples = 0;
  expect(judge("reference", all, metrics, failure === "bursts" ? 0 : 12, 12, failure === "invariant" ? 1 : 0, true, failure === "busy" ? 0 : 1).referencePass).toBe(false);
});
it.each(["", "-wal"])("never resets an existing seed target or sidecar %s [QLT-05]", async suffix => {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "workload-seed-guard-")), path = join(dir, "guard.db");
  try {
    writeFileSync(path + suffix, "preserve me");
    await expect(seed(path, "synthetic fixture value")).rejects.toThrow(/new dedicated/);
    expect(readFileSync(path + suffix, "utf8")).toBe("preserve me");
    expect(readdirSync(dir)).toEqual([`guard.db${suffix}`]);
  } finally { rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});

it("provides every baseline client enough owned active loans for the complete measured cycle [QLT-05]", async () => {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "workload-inventory-")), path = join(dir, "app.db");
  try {
    await seed(path, "synthetic fixture value");
    const db = new Database(path, { readonly: true });
    try {
      for (let index = 0; index < 20; index++) {
        const actual = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM loans WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'active'").all(`user-${index}`) as Array<{ id: string }>;
        expect(actual.length).toBeGreaterThan(150_000 / 250 / 10);
        expect(new Set(actual.map(row => row.id))).toEqual(new Set(initialLoans(index)));
      }
      expect(initialLoans(20)).toEqual([]);
    } finally { db.close(); }
  } finally { rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
});
